source: Loom's status record, maintained in the repository and checked against main

items.label: Loom implements Commission's AgentExecutor
items.detail: Over Commission's generated model: a run projects the frontier, selects over that catalogue, asks Commission's admission check, and returns an executor outcome.

items.label: The run ends at a ProposedAction
items.detail: No effect is invoked from Loom.

items.label: Actions that need authority are proposed for Commission to authorize
items.detail: Loom never suspends for authority; Commission rechecks the proposal and asks its authority provider (Atlas ADR 0082).

items.label: An unavailable selector or argument generator suspends the run
items.detail: Suspended with ExternalAvailability, carrying the error.

items.label: Commission makes the effect call
items.detail: Atlas ADR 0082. The Commission side is planned work in Commission.

items.label: Catalogue projection
items.detail: The frontier projected to one entry per distinct action, at its first position, its status decided by Commission admission.

items.label: Selections outside the catalogue are refused
items.detail: The catalogue lists only actions Commission admission does not refuse. Loom::select refuses an action id the catalogue does not list (NotInCatalogue), whatever its confidence; Loom::run then ends with NoUsefulAction and generates no arguments.

items.label: ActionSelector and ArgumentGenerator traits
items.detail: A selector is given the selection context and the entries of the projected catalogue and returns one choice; arguments are a JSON string.

items.label: Bootstrap selector and empty-arguments generator
items.detail: For tests and examples only: the first admissible action, with {} as its arguments.

items.label: Schema validation of arguments, revalidation inside Loom
items.detail: Their commands are declared in the specification; neither is built yet.

items.label: Reasoning-model, fast typed and hybrid selectors; confidence fallback; selection telemetry
Run model generated from ESS
items.detail: Session, Turn, ActionCatalogue, Selection and ArgumentRequest are synthesized from ess/ and re-exported; none is written by hand.

items.label: ESS specification and its hard gate
items.detail: The loom.run domain; task check fails unless it validates, compiles, synthesizes with no refusals and carries no open question.

items.label: Harness crates ported
items.detail: The provider wires, messages, responses, HTTP and the turn loop of Harness 798325f0, as modules of b10x-loom; not yet wired to a run.

items.label: Harness loop wired to the run
items.detail: Sessions and transcripts, streaming, compaction, budgets, interruption and recovery.
